question_text: Probationary employee ako sa private warehouse. Noong last week lang nila ipinakita yung standards. What should I understand about that?
A private office put me on probation. They explained the standards only near the end. What does the rule say?
Private factory staff ako. Minsan isang buwan lang ang sahod. Tama ba yung pagitan ng payday?
I bought a portable fan from an appliance shop. It ran briefly and then stopped. The seller refuses to discuss a replacement. What consumer rule applies?
The gadget shop called this laptop brand new, but it was refurbished. What does the consumer framework say about that description?
Sabi ng retailer brand new yung tablet, pero used pala. What consumer rules should I read?
May warranty card ako sa bagong oven. The retailer says I should complain to the distributor. What responsibility does the retailer have?
An online shop delivered the wrong headphones. The delivered model has different features. If I choose replacement, what return rules apply?
Our private office shut for a regular holiday. The employees were told no work means no pay. What is the general holiday rule?
Sa private packaging company kami. Hindi binayaran ang overtime ko. What general rule applies?
My private employer delayed wages. Separately, an appliance store refuses my warranty claim. Please explain the two concerns.
My private employer deducted missing equipment from my salary. Separately, my bank charged a loan penalty. Which issue can this project explain?
Government employee ako disputing salary. Separately, a local store delivered a broken fan. Explain the purchase concern.
Seafarer ako. My question is about the employment terms for my overseas vessel assignment.
Probationary ako sa government office. Saka lang nila sinabi yung standards. What civil-service procedure applies?
The insurer denied my personal policy claim. Can you tell me the insurance complaint process?
My landlord kept the rental deposit. Which housing remedy applies?
Sa private packaging company ako.
They did not meet the requirements. What can I do?
Sa private hotel ako. Unpaid ang overtime, pero hindi ito government employment. What overtime rule applies?
I work for a private company. My only concern is a retailer refusing the warranty on a broken kettle I bought.
A local shop sold me a faulty oven. A different shop kept my cash change. Please explain each purchase issue.
My private employer dismissed me. A different private employer has not paid wages from my other job. What rules cover each concern?
An online store sent a damaged lamp. My neighbor also published my personal information. Please explain the consumer part and where your scope ends.
